unit.why: The division holds two separate anecdotes about the Seer of Lublin, both told by the Holy Jew of Peshischa: one about escorting a woman, one about his far-sight on the Sabbath before his wedding.

stories.start_quote: פ"א סיפר הרה״ק מפרשיסחא איך שפ"א
stories.end_quote: לשמור את עצמו מזה איך להתנהג
stories.summary_en: The Seer of Lublin escorts a woman visitor to the corridor and tells his disciples that whoever knows the secret of escorting knows how to guard himself against the talmudic ban on walking behind a woman.

stories.summary_en: On the Sabbath before his wedding to Rebbetzin Beila, the Seer tells his followers what she is doing at home at that moment. He explains that he was born able to see from one end of the world to the other, asked God to take this from him because of the world's evil, and still sees four hundred parasangs as if they were four cubits.

quotes: הגיד לאנשי שלומו מה היא עושה בביתה כעת
בכחו להסתכל מסוף העולם ועד סופו
לשבת שקודם נשואיו עם הרבנית בילא
tags.why: The setting is the period of his wedding.
The episode takes place on the Sabbath before the wedding.

quotes: הרבנית בילא ע"ה גיסתו של הרב
tags.why: His bride, the future rebbetzin, is the object of his vision.
The bride is described but does not act in the scene.
He speaks to and explains himself to his followers.
It continues the Peshischa rebbe's narration.
